_comment: Legend for the flat fill colours painted on
sources/terraqueous_globe_reprojected - strategic_regions.png (board #2931).
User confirmed 2026-09-05: these colours are arbitrary MS Paint swatch picks
(left-to-right palette order) and carry NO relationship to
mapgen/config/old_world_region_colors.json's colours -- classify by exact RGB
against THIS file only, never by cross-referencing the other legend.
'realm' is the strategic-region slug this colour's pixels vote for
(assign_realms in mapgen/worldgen/land_naming.py). 'file_stem' is the existing
map_data/state_regions/NN_<file_stem>.txt stub this realm's STATE_LAND blocks
are written into -- several realms below intentionally share one file_stem
(the four Karaz Ankor sub-realms; the two Dark Lands sub-realms), each still
getting its own 'region_<realm>' block in common/strategic_regions/.
'continent' groups realms into the common/strategic_regions/<continent>_
strategic_regions.txt file that realm's region_<realm> block is written into
-- mirrors vanilla's own continent-scoped files (europe_strategic_regions.txt,
east_asia_strategic_regions.txt, ...; user decision 2026-09-05). Land of the
Dead (nehekhara), Araby and the Southern World's Edge Mountains read as the
southlands continent despite Nehekhara's file_stem staying 'nehekhara' for
the state-file split -- continent and file_stem are independent groupings.
(0, 255, 255) pure cyan is NOT a realm fill -- confirmed by pixel analysis:
its pixels trace thin coastline tracery across the ENTIRE canvas (bbox spans
the full image) rather than filling one solid region, i.e. it is the base
art's coastline reference bleeding into this layer. Deliberately excluded
from 'fills' below; classify_fills must ignore it (treat as unclassified/
no-vote), never assign it a realm.
Recoloured 2026-10-24 (Chris): the painting is now the strategic_regions layer
of full.ora, with colours picked to be distinguishable (blue steps of 20 in the
(0, 0, n) and (0, 20, n) ranges); the swatch colours described above are gone.
Araby has no colour in the new layer, so it has no fill. New realms: athel_loren
(shares the brettonia stub), northern_badlands / southern_badlands (share the
badlands stub), ocean_of_dread_islands (stub southlands) and far_ocean_islands
(stub nippon). The stub and continent for these five are Claude's pick, placed
by geography; Chris to confirm. (255, 0, 255) is the 'border' entry below.

excluded.reason: coastline reference tracery, not a realm fill -- see _comment

border.reason: magenta state/province subdivision network, not a fill -- matches MARKER_RGB elsewhere in the pipeline
